Yes — I added task comments support.

What changed:
- Added comment storage and retrieval in the task API.
- Added `POST /api/tasks/:id/comments` to append comments to an existing task.
- Included comments in `GET /api/tasks` and `GET /api/tasks/:id` responses.
- Updated the UI so you can add a comment and view all comments when reopening a task.
- Added tests for creating tasks with comments and adding comments later.
- Updated the README to mention the new comment feature.

I also verified everything with the test suite, and it passes.
